verdict.rationale: Floot is a SaaS app-building platform, so offering a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. However, probes of every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no documentation mentions a published API spec. The official MCP server and llms.txt are separate capabilities and do not count as an OpenAPI-equivalent spec here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
